mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET pay_status = 1, third_trade_no = #{thirdTradeNo}, paid_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND pay_status = 0 AND deleted = 0

UPDATE payment SET refund_amount = IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) + #{refundAmount}, pay_status = IF(IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) + #{refundAmount} >= amount, 3, pay_status), updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND pay_status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND IFNULL(refund_amount, 0) + #{refundAmount} <= amount
